page_title: Speechify: Text to Speech & Voice Typing AI Assistant | 60M+ Users

summary.name: Speechify
summary.one_liner: Speechify is a text-to-speech and voice AI assistant that reads PDFs, web pages, books and documents aloud, and offers voice typing, AI note taking and AI podcast creation.
use_cases: listen to PDFs, articles and books on the go
dictate emails and documents instead of typing
take AI notes from meetings and calls
study by listening to course material
summary.what_it_does: Speechify reads text aloud using AI voices across web, Chrome and Edge extensions, iOS, Android and Mac/Windows apps. Users can upload PDFs, EPUB, DOCX, TXT and other files, paste text, or scan pages with OCR and have them read back, with text highlighting and adjustable speed. Its Voice Typing/dictation feature turns speech into text in any app, with the page claiming it is faster than typing. A Voice AI Assistant answers questions about what is being read, and the app can summarize content, create podcasts from documents or descriptions, and take meeting notes. The page says it offers over 1,000 voices in more than 60 languages.
notable: Voice Typing dictation that works in any app, including Google Docs and Gmail
Over 1,000 AI voices in 60+ languages with up to 4.5x playback speed
Text to speech API that the page says powers its own products
Scan & Listen uses OCR to read physical text from a photo
caveats: Premium features such as offline listening and some advanced voices require a paid plan; a free trial of premium is offered
Bulk plans for schools and teams require contacting sales
Speed and accuracy claims (such as 160 words per minute dictation) are marketing statements from the page
